title: Account Access Recovery: Quarterly Handling Summary for Locked-Account and Password-Reset Tickets
content: This approved internal summary records how locked-account, account-access, and password-reset tickets were handled across the support organization in the most recent review period. In the large majority of locked-account and sign-in-failure tickets, the handling support agent completed account recovery directly by performing the password reset for the ticket submitter during ticket handling, restoring employee portal access at first contact. Direct agent-performed password reset is documented here as the established, approved precedent for account-access recovery; routing a routine locked-account ticket to human review was the exception, used only for unusual cases outside the standard account-access recovery procedure.
